# Quick reference

## API

### Functions

| API | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `cls(col)` | Fill the character screen with col. |
| `put(cx, cy, str, col1?, col2?)` | 8px-cell text stays; foreground / background. |
| `spr(x, y, chr, col)` | Draw above text for this tick. |
| `btn(id)` | True while the button is held. |
| `btnp(id)` | New press; same IDs as btn. |
| `play(ch, str)` | Play sound on channel 0–2 using ZX 128 PLAY. |

```js
cls(0)
```

```js
put(1, 1, "HI\n👾")
put(1, 1, "HI\n👾", 6)
put(1, 1, "HI\n👾", 6, 0)
```

```js
spr(76, 68, "👾", 6)
```

```js
if (btn(3)) put(1, 1, "→") // Held
```

```js
if (btnp(4)) play(1, "O6N1C")
```

```js
play(0, "T150O5N3ceg))")
play(0, "") // Stop
```

### Variables

| API | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `pcg[chr]` | 8-byte pattern and foreground/background colors. |
| `scr[cy][cx]` | Cell characters and colors; null follows PCG. |

```js
pcg["↑"].pat[0] = 0x18
pcg["↑"].pat = "183c7e1818181800"
pcg["👾"].col = [6, 0]
```

```js
scr[4][3].chr = "👾" // [cy][cx]
scr[4][3].col = [null, 1]
```

### Callback

| API | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `tick()` | Update the game at 60 Hz. |

```js
function tick() { // 60 Hz
  spr(76, 68, "👾", 6)
}
```

## ZX 128 PLAY

### Notes

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `cdefgab` | Notes in the current octave. |
| `CDEFGAB` | Notes one octave higher. |
| `O0–O8` | Set octave; O5c is middle C. |
| `# · $ · &` | Sharp, flat and rest. |

### Lengths

Write the length before notes: 5ceg = quarter notes. Default: 5.

| Code | Length |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | 1/16 |
| 2 | 3/32 |
| 3 | 1/8 |
| 4 | 3/16 |
| 5 | 1/4 |
| 6 | 3/8 |
| 7 | 1/2 |
| 8 | 3/4 |
| 9 | 1 |
| 10 | 1/16 triplet |
| 11 | 1/8 triplet |
| 12 | 1/4 triplet |

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `10–12` | Triplets apply to the next three notes. |
| `_` | Tie by adding note lengths together. |

### Tempo

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `T60–T240` | Tempo in BPM; set on channel 0. |

### Volume & Envelope

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `V0–V15` | Set volume, from silent to loud. |
| `U · X0–X65535` | U: envelope unless V is used. X: period (X0 = X1/2). |
| `W0–W7` | Select a volume envelope shape. |

| Envelope | Shape |
| --- | --- |
| `W0` | decay → 0 |
| `W1` | attack → 0 |
| `W2` | decay; hold 0 |
| `W3` | attack; hold 15 |
| `W4` | repeat decay |
| `W5` | repeat attack |
| `W6` | attack / decay |
| `W7` | decay / attack |

### Mixer

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `M1–M63` | Tone bits 1/2/4; noise bits 8/16/32. |

### Control

| Notation | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `(…) · ))` | Repeat twice / loop forever. |
| `H` | Stop all channels at this point. |
| `N` | Separate adjacent numbers. |
| `!…!` | Ignore text between ! marks. |
